newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court rejects gov't CVRD appeal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court rejects gov't CVRD appeal.

text.p: Brazil's highest court, the Supreme Federal Tribunal, rejected an appeal by the government against an injunction involving its plan to privatize mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce.
A spokesman for the Supreme Federal Tribunal (STF) said the injunction, which suspended a presidential decree transfering 411,000 hectares of a major mining area to CVRD, would stand.

Lawyers representing Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), which lodged the appeal, said they expected not to win the decision and stressed the injunction would not affect next Monday's auction of 40-45 percent of CVRD's voting capital.

"People should not mix up the issue of land rights with the issue of mining rights," said Luiz Roberto Magalhaes, the BNDES' legal manager. "The injunction affects the first of those two issues but not the second."
The ruling might have caused some investors to be "perplexed" but none were worried, he said.
